a.lede: Several U.S. banks are blocking AI agents from making transactions on their platforms. They fear that those agents could go rogue and there's no way to tell if the moves they make are legitimate or not.
a.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity

b.lede: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
b.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
